sub_graphs.title: Precompiled Contract Dispatch Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models how the EVM routes calls to precompiled contract addresses

nodes.label: Call to Contract Address
nodes.description: EVM is executing a CALL/STATICCALL/DELEGATECALL to a target address

nodes.label: Check if Address is Precompile
nodes.description: Look up address in PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS dictionary

nodes.label: Address is Precompile
nodes.description: The target address exists in PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS mapping

nodes.label: Address is Not Precompile
nodes.description: Address not in precompile mapping, treat as regular contract

nodes.label: Retrieve Handler Function
nodes.description: Get the callable function from the dictionary for this address

nodes.label: Handler Function Retrieved
nodes.description: The specific precompile implementation function is ready

nodes.label: Execute Precompile Handler
nodes.description: Invoke the retrieved function with the call data

nodes.label: Precompile Execution Complete
nodes.description: Precompile has processed input and produced output

ambiguities.text: The exact numerical addresses for each precompile are defined as constants elsewhere but not shown in this mapping file
Behavior when calling a precompile address with insufficient gas to even check the mapping is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the mapping lookup itself is free; gas is only charged by the precompile implementation after dispatch.

implicit_assumptions.description: The PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS mapping is immutable during execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the mapping could be modified at runtime, arbitrary code could be executed at precompile addresses.

implicit_assumptions.description: Precompile addresses (0x01-0x0a) cannot have regular contract code deployed to them
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If contracts could be deployed at precompile addresses, the special handling would be bypassed.

implicit_assumptions.description: All precompile implementations are correct and have been audited
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bugs in precompile implementations could break consensus or enable exploits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork-specific module path is correctly resolved during EVM initialization
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect module loading could result in wrong precompile set being active.
